description: Can add an owner to an application or service principal (owners can then add credentials).

telemetry.detail: Entra ID audit log: 'Add owner to application / Add owner to service principal' (directory logging is default-on).
Anomaly policies may flag ownership changes on privileged apps.

prerequisite_privilege: Owner or a directory role permitting ownership changes
abuse_primitive: Add a controlled principal as owner of a privileged app, then add a secret.
notes: Ownership change is audited; usually a stepping stone to AZAddSecret.
